solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Incline to welcome unknown scorer?

indicators.note: to welcome a guest is to take them inside, so one part goes within the other

blocks.note: a ship that lists leans to one side
algebra uses x, y and z for unknowns

explanation.surface: Someone leaning in to greet a mysterious goalscorer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scorer' suggests sport; here it is someone who writes musical scores.
explanation.definitionFit: Liszt was a Hungarian composer, and a composer writes scores, hence the question mark.

clue.text: One applied to feeding minor?

indicators.note: feeding puts something inside, as food goes into a mouth

blocks.note: on as in put on, applied
minor and lesser both mean smaller

explanation.surface: Someone tasked with feeding a child.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: the minor is a cub, and a big-cat mother feeds it.
explanation.definitionFit: A lioness is the female lion that suckles and hunts for her cubs.

clue.text: I am flourishing because of special branch of medicine being fresh

blocks.note: pert in an old sense means lively, in good health
in as in by reason of

explanation.surface: A medical specialist feeling sprightly.
explanation.walkthrough: Special Branch is a police unit, but here it is a medical specialism.
explanation.definitionFit: Fresh in its informal sense means cheeky or impudent.

clue.text: Believer in a vital force left in second place of the hardly celebs?

indicators.note: the second position of the word is taken over by a new letter

blocks.note: zoism is the belief in a vital life force

explanation.surface: A vitalist ranked second among the barely famous.
explanation.definitionFit: The Z-list is the lowest tier of celebrities, people barely known at all.

clue.text: Square chin in detective is strictly procedural detail?

indicators.note: to square something is to adjust it, putting it into new shape
in places one part inside the other

explanation.surface: A detective with a square jaw is a stickler for procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Technics are technical details or methods, the mechanics of doing something by the book.

clue.text: Seed split and removed from kelp, say — not a little impressive

indicators.note: removing something from a word takes those letters out, leaving the rest

blocks.note: kelp is an example of seaweed
the word seed in two parts, one at each end
some is a fair amount, not just a little

explanation.surface: A marine biologist marvels at seeds teased out of kelp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seed split' means the word is cut in two, with one part at each end of the kelp word, so removing it leaves the core.
explanation.definitionFit: Something awesome inspires wonder, which is exactly what an impressive sight does.

clue.text: Process I had about flipping goodbyes

indicators.note: flipping something over turns it the other way round

blocks.note: to sue is to bring legal process

explanation.surface: A litigant had a flipping process, and said farewells.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is French for farewell, used in English as a parting word.

clue.text: Spook woman, one in chariot

indicators.note: one in the chariot is a passenger riding inside it, so the numeral goes within the vehicle

blocks.note: a rath is an Indian chariot

explanation.surface: A ghostly woman riding in a chariot.
explanation.definitionFit: A wraith is a ghost or apparition, which spook means informally.

clue.text: Well split by independent Journal's three-line verse

indicators.note: split by means wedged open with something inserted

blocks.note: so, as an interjection like well

explanation.surface: A newspaper splits a column to print a short poem.
explanation.walkthrough: Independent and Journal look like newspaper titles but each supplies an abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Sijo is a Korean poetic form of three lines.

clue.text: Rocket previously sharp pest

blocks.note: the flaming onion was a First World War anti-aircraft rocket
fly in slang means sharp, quick-witted

explanation.surface: A rocket that was once sharp has become a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: Rocket looks like the salad leaf, which fits a garden pest, but it is the wartime weapon. 'previously' puts it first.
explanation.definitionFit: The onion fly is an insect whose larvae damage onion crops.

clue.text: Peas from marshlands in the Borders male scythed

indicators.note: scything cuts something down and away

blocks.note: merse is a Scots word for fertile riverside marsh

explanation.surface: Peas from Scottish marshland, harvested by a man with a scythe.
explanation.walkthrough: The Borders is the Scottish border region, signalling a Scots word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ers is the bitter vetch, a leguminous plant of the pea family.

clue.text: Farmhand's gadget mere lad manufactured with iron

indicators.note: something manufactured is made from raw material into a new form

explanation.surface: A mere farm lad has knocked together a gadget out of iron.
explanation.definitionFit: A mole drainer is a farm implement that cuts underground drainage channels through clay fields.

clue.text: Exigency led to shift to an extreme extent

indicators.note: shifting things moves them into new positions

explanation.surface: An emergency forced a change of plan to an extreme degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Exceedingly is an adverb meaning very much, to a great degree.

clue.text: Barnacles are my business — pick here for French article

explanation.surface: A marine biologist's motto, plus a French lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: Barnacles look like sea creatures, but it is old slang for spectacles.
explanation.definitionFit: Spectacles, slangily called barnacles, are what this professional examines eyes for and supplies.

clue.text: Dope's sewn up

indicators.note: up as in messed up or stirred up, signalling disorder

explanation.walkthrough: Dope looks like an idiot or a drug; it is slang for the low-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Dope is slang for inside information, the latest news on something.

clue.text: Act of Chancellor? Cashier due to slip on Twitter?

definitions.text: Cashier due to slip on Twitter?

blocks.note: CE abbreviates Chancellor of the Exchequer

explanation.surface: A finance minister fired a cashier for a careless tweet.
explanation.walkthrough: Cashier here is a verb meaning dismiss. The word comes from the blogger Dooce, sacked in 2002 for writing about her workplace online.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dooced is to be fired for what you post on social media or a blog.

clue.text: Break bust incorporating classic blokey bloke above Troy

indicators.note: incorporating means taking into the body of something

blocks.note: a herm is a bust on a squared pillar
Alf Garnett, the bigot of the British sitcom Till Death Us Do Part

explanation.surface: A broken statue of a classic hero above Troy.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'above' puts one piece before the next. Troy is the weight system, not the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Half-term is the short school holiday in the middle of a British school term.

clue.text: Fruitcake desperately wants ____

blocks.note: fruitcake is slang for a crazy person, a nut
to pine is to long for

explanation.surface: A fill-in-the-blank: what does the crazy person crave?
explanation.walkthrough: The blank is filled by the answer itself: a fruitcake would want nuts, and nut pines bear edible seeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut pines are pine trees with large edible seeds, such as the stone pine, which a fruitcake recipe might use.

clue.text: One thrashing about inside leaves states of bondage

indicators.note: thrashing about is wild disordered movement
inside places one thing within another

explanation.surface: Someone thrashing among fallen leaves while in captivity.
explanation.definitionFit: Peonage is a system of servitude where labourers are bound to work off debts.

clue.text: Stable state is behind returning aptitude tests

indicators.note: something returning comes back the way it went, so it is read backwards

explanation.surface: A stable result in aptitude tests that keep being retaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is behind' tells you which way round the pieces go.
explanation.definitionFit: Stasis is a condition of equilibrium in which nothing changes.

clue.text: Offspring carrying mark of iron?

indicators.note: to carry something is to hold it within

blocks.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A child bearing a branding mark.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a young cow carries the mark of a branding iron.
explanation.definitionFit: A heifer is a young cow, typically branded with a hot iron to show ownership.

clue.text: She won't give reference, a long established legal right

blocks.note: in law, user is a right acquired by long use

explanation.surface: A former employer will not provide a reference.
explanation.definitionFit: A refuser is someone who declines to give or grant something.

clue.text: Grouse mixed with this mineral could appear sacrilegious

indicators.note: mixing things together jumbles their parts into one blend

blocks.note: taken as written; the mixture of both words

explanation.surface: Complaining about a mineral might be blasphemous.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite: GROUSE plus the answer is an anagram of SACRILEGIOUS, so remove GROUSE's letters and rearrange what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Silica is silicon dioxide, the mineral found as quartz and sand.

clue.text: Missile launcher (anti-tank) on latitude 50

blocks.note: lat is the abbreviation for latitude

explanation.surface: An anti-tank missile launcher stationed on the fiftieth parallel.
explanation.walkthrough: Fifty looks like the latitude's degree but is a separate Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlatl is an Aztec spear-thrower used to hurl darts or spears.

clue.text: Twist in narrative catching half-cut person no longer passed up

indicators.note: cut in half means only one half of the word survives
to catch something is to hold it inside

blocks.note: a node is a plot complication
a soul is a person, as in not a soul

explanation.surface: A plot twist about a drunk who has been overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: Half-cut looks like drunk; it means keep half of SOUL. 'No longer' marks an archaic Spenserian word.
explanation.definitionFit: Spenser's noulde means would not, the old sense of refusing or turning down.

clue.text: Born to keep oil up and down and up?

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means reading from the bottom
to keep is to hold within

explanation.surface: A baby being oiled, a riddle about rising and falling.
explanation.definitionFit: Nebulé in heraldry is a line drawn in wavy cloud-like curves, rising and falling.

clue.text: Release new tune about fantastic fans

indicators.note: making something new reshapes it
fantastic suggests wild invention, so the letters are rearranged freely
about means around, one set placed around the other

explanation.surface: Releasing a new song about devoted followers.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten is to undo a fastening, letting something loose.

clue.text: Upper-class dimness you didn't get, we hear, in northern uni once

indicators.note: what we hear is the spoken sound, not the spelling

blocks.note: U is the classic label for upper-class usage
mist is dimness; missed is what you didn't get

explanation.surface: A posh student who failed to grasp lectures at an old northern university.
explanation.walkthrough: UMIST was the University of Manchester Institute of Science and Technology, merged in 2004.
explanation.definitionFit: The former Manchester institute was a university in northern England until its merger.

clue.text: Capuchin against a sectarian

blocks.note: the sai is the capuchin monkey

explanation.surface: A Capuchin friar stands opposed to a sectarian.
explanation.walkthrough: Capuchin suggests a friar; it is the monkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saiva is a member of the Hindu sect devoted to Shiva.

clue.text: What's integral to some tremendous work by Pope, perhaps

definitions.text: What's integral to some tremendous work by Pope, perhaps

indicators.note: integral to means forming an inner part of, so the letters sit inside

explanation.surface: Asking what underpins a great poem by Alexander Pope.
explanation.walkthrough: Pope is the 18th-century poet Alexander Pope, not the pontiff.
explanation.definitionFit: Metre is the rhythmic pattern of verse, essential to Pope's heroic couplets.

clue.text: Take remedy endlessly being a type of eastern nettle

indicators.note: without an end means the final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A prescription for an eastern stinging nettle.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhea is another name for ramie, an Asian plant of the nettle family grown for fibre.

clue.text: Something to eat Ionian character is eastern vernacular

blocks.note: ai is an edible fish, the ayu
nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A dish that bears an Ionian personality speaks a local dialect.
explanation.definitionFit: Ainu is the language of the indigenous people of northern Japan.

clue.text: Measurements from tools in sets having new GUI installed

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement
installing something puts it inside

blocks.note: a gang is a set of tools used together

explanation.surface: Surveying from toolkits with a new graphical user interface installed.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaugings are measurings taken with a gauge.

clue.text: Easy setter, even for the masses

indicators.note: easy suggests loose and relaxed, so the letters are let free

blocks.note: even and level both mean flat or equal

explanation.surface: A setter going easy so that everyone can solve.
explanation.walkthrough: Easy Street suggests itself, but Easy is the signal to rearrange SETTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Street-level describes things at the level of ordinary people, popular rather than elite.

clue.text: Panel split by American is open for cultivation

indicators.note: a thing split by another has that other wedged into it

blocks.note: a table is a flat panel or slab

explanation.surface: An American breaks into a panel that is open to being cultivated.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamable means able to be tamed, and cultivating something wild is to tame it.

clue.text: Placed close to younger Silenus, eg

blocks.note: yr is an abbreviation of younger

explanation.surface: Seated near a younger Silenus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close to' is a position, not a letter selection.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Silenus was the elderly companion of Dionysus, counted among the satyrs.
